notes: Isolation-care staff use the existing serving local administrator and capacity, with the civic minimum administration skill. No workers, research or stocks are granted.
Commissioning consumes the district's existing medical materials. Annual upkeep is prepaid; actual exposed care consumes one additional medical stock unit per day. Preparation is 90 days.

Records operate only during paid isolation care or a paid medical response. Clinical research authorizes the existing response action, with its unchanged bill, quarantine, duration and cooldown; only Anatomy supplies its separate 2500 bp contribution.
Daily records payment is atomic: one minor treasury currency and one existing cloth stock. Absence of an outbreak or exposed manpower consumes no daily treatment inputs.
